decision: Treat rule reading as learned and redirect the held-out-family gap to computation
why: v3 reads edited and unseen rules in the same three question shapes, yet the locked held-out families stayed at 67 to 70% across v1, v2 and v3, and hard-v1 temporal_numeric stays near 53%
result: Next step is generated time-window, deadline and balance rules with their own held-out set; the locked test items are not inspected to design it
